text: Understanding databases is essential for anyone working with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which organise data into rows and columns. To retrieve or change information, you use queries written in a special language. Good data modeling helps you design tables that fit your needs and avoid mistakes. Indexes are also important because they make searches much faster, especially when tables contain a lot of records. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, offer more flexible structures and are useful for large or rapidly changing data. Choosing the right database depends on your project.
